map.数码印花参数计算器，输入分辨率、打印面积与墨水类型求墨水用量与打印精度，辅助数码: Digital Printing Parameter Calculator: enter the resolution, print area, and ink type to get the ink consumption and print resolution, supporting cost accounting for digital printing.
map.数码印花成本估算：由面积、覆盖率与墨水单价估算单件墨耗成本。: Digital printing cost estimate: derive the per-unit ink cost from the area, coverage, and ink unit price.
map.打印精度与速度权衡：高 dpi 精度高但慢，按图案精细度选档。: Print quality versus speed: a high dpi is more accurate but slower, so pick the level by how fine the pattern is.
map.墨水采购计划：按订单量累计墨耗，安排活性/分散/颜料/酸性墨水备货。: Ink procurement planning: accumulate ink consumption from order volume and stock reactive, disperse, pigment, and acid inks accordingly.
map.活性墨水数码印花墨耗示例: Reactive ink digital printing ink consumption example
: With a print area of 1.0 m², average coverage 8%, 720 dpi, and reactive ink density about 1.05 g/mL, converting 1.0×8% by the unit ink layer thickness gives a few tens of grams of ink; multiply by the unit price for the per-unit ink cost and then by the order quantity for stocking.
map.dpi 越高越好吗？: Is a Higher dpi Always Better?
map.高 dpi 细节更锐利，但喷印变慢、墨耗上升；普通图案 360~720 dpi: A high dpi gives sharper detail but slows printing and raises ink use; 360–720 dpi is enough for ordinary patterns, and only image-grade fine detail needs more.
map.活性（棉麻）、分散（涤纶）、酸性（丝毛尼龙）、颜料（多纤维通用）适用纤维不同，固: Reactive (cotton and linen), disperse (polyester), acid (silk, wool, nylon), and pigment (all fibre types) suit different fibres, use different fixing processes, and differ in ink consumption and unit price.
map.按图案像素占比或经验目测；满地色接近 100%，稀疏线条可能低于 5%，影响墨耗: Judged from the pixel coverage of the pattern or by eye; a solid full-coverage pattern approaches 100% while a sparse line pattern can be below 5%, which affects the accuracy of ink consumption estimates.
